Definition: as card. one; as article single; as an ordinal, first; adverbially, at once
BiblicalUsage: Chad is the Aramaic word for one — first, single, only. It stands at the head of the letter Rehum wrote against Jerusalem, it marks the first year of Cyrus, the one great image of Nebuchadnezzar's dream, and the one decree hanging over the wise men who could not tell it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe one is the loneliest number in Daniel: one image, one decree, one God who knows the dream. When everything comes down to one, it comes down to Him.
